# Purpose ledger

| ID | Question | When | Default | Fails without | Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| queue-screen | What needs me? | Glance | Quiet work queue | Work is hard to find | Five-second glance |
| queue-heading | Where am I? | Glance | Named header | Context lost | Header stable at zoom |
| queue-list | Which item is next? | Glance | Grouped rows | Order unclear | Keyboard reaches each |
| work-card | Which work and what state? | Glance | Icon, name, state | Rows merge visually | Equal insets, long-title overflow |
| draft-composer | What direction do I want to add? | Writing | Label and input | Direction lost | Draft survives arrival |
| sample-controls | Can I replay the sample? | Prototype review | Play, pause, replay, reset | Simulation unclear | Paused on load, deterministic replay |
